notes.title: Gal Guardians: Servants of the Dark has been updated to version 1.5.0
notes.notes:
(Updated July 31th, 2025)

4th Update

・A new gameplay Style, "Ultimaid", is now available after clearing the game.
・The servant Akromatik now offers an in-game illustration gallery.
・A new event starts with the servant Orlan after meeting certain conditions.
・New sub-weapons, "Royal Arms" and "Summon Pod" are available.
・Some parts of the map, enemies, and weapon skills have been adjusted for balance.
・Various other parts of the game have been adjusted for balance.

■Notice of postponement of online multiplayer
Originally scheduled for implementation in the 4th monthly update, online multiplayer has been unfortunately postponed to achieve stability on all platforms. 
We sincerely apologize to the players who were looking forward to this crucial feature. 
Currently, we estimate that we will be able to release the feature in Fall 2025. We will announced when a more specific date is determined.
The team is striving as hard as possible to get online working for players even a single day earlier. We humbly ask for your patience.

notes.title: Gal Guardians: Servants of the Dark has been updated to version 1.4.0
notes.notes:
(Updated June 30th, 2025)

3rd Update

・Castle servants Cyclo and Kyuklo now provide special consumable items during multiplayer.
・The servants Blobby can now help with managing unneeded items and equipment.
・A new sub-quest featuring Karon has been added. Start it by finding a certain item...
・New sub-weapons, "Buckler Sword" and "Summon Cactus" are available.
・Parts of the map and some enemies have been adjusted for balance.
・Various other parts of the game have been adjusted for balance.

notes.title: Gal Guardians: Servants of the Dark has been updated to version 1.3.0
notes.notes:
(Updated May 29th, 2025)

2nd Update

・A feature has been added to the servant "Muertos", allowing players to increase item drop rates.
・A new event has been added to the servant "Drydas" where players can earn a new item.
・New demon charms have been added.
・Some demon charms have been adjusted.
・The enemy balance in some areas has been adjusted.
・Other various aspects of the game have been adjusted for balance.

notes.title: Gal Guardians: Servants of the Dark has been updated to version 1.2.2
notes.notes:
(Updated April 25th, 2025)

■Ver.1.2.2 Patch Notes
・Various minor issues have been fixed.

notes.title: Gal Guardians: Servants of the Dark has been updated to version 1.2.1
notes.notes:
(Updated April 24th, 2025)

1st Update

・A new event, the "Arena", has been added.
・New boss fights, "Baphomet" and "Hell Infernoctavius", have been added to the Arena.
・Inventory items can now be locked.
・A new icon has been added for improved sub-weapons to distinguish them.
・A count of demon lord bones available in each area is now displayed on the map.
・Players are now able to warp from the tea table in Maxim Castle to the most recently used tea table outside.
・When meeting the requirements for the True Ending, players can now select either the True Ending or the Normal Ending.
・Some enemies have been adjusted for balance.
・Some areas of gameplay have been adjusted for balance.
・Various adjustments have been made to improve game balance.

notes.title: Gal Guardians: Servants of the Dark has been updated to version 1.1.3
notes.notes:
(Updated March 27th, 2025)

■Ver.1.1.3 Patch Notes
・Situations where the playable characters can pass through terrain have been fixed.
・Load optimizations have been made to improve the frame rate in places.
・When loading a save originally created on the demo version, achievements earned during the demo will be unlocked.
・Various other issues have been fixed.
